title: 第10章 趟子房和野兔子-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》
content:
第(1/3)页

    大黄的速度很快，野兔的速度也快，但是野兔的持久力不行，只是爆发力惊人，长时间奔跑会将自己活生生跑死，只要不是什么复杂的地形，野兔逃脱不了大黄的猎杀。

    不过。

    大黄猎杀野兔有太多的可能性，也有可能会惊动前来饮水的其他猎物。

    李青山眼疾手快，拉满手中长弓。

    前世那一把力气虽然没有继承，但是前世的知识和经验，可是完美继承了回来。

    猎弓满月！！

    瞄准，呼吸！

    “欻！”

    下一秒！

    双脚站稳，间距大概是自己肩宽的一点五倍，老林子内树叶轻响，风速大概是三米每秒，自己与野兔间隔三十米，在有效精准的猎杀范围之内。

    稍微朝着野兔的身位偏离一些。

    满月猎弓之中，长箭飞射而出，空中留下一道残影！

    这一切，都是在剑拔弩张的转瞬间完成，李青山早已对射箭的技巧，熟记于心，虽然后来玩了枪，但李青山还是很喜欢古法的长弓，所以经常和那些年迈的老军人去狩猎。

    “嘭！”

    一道沉闷声响，正在奔跑的野兔来不及反应，一根长箭便瞬间洞穿了脖颈！！

    剧烈奔跑的身子几个翻滚，便倒在地上不断抽搐着。

    大黄冲了过来，叼起野兔便朝着李青山跑了过来，然后将其放在李青山脚边，晃了晃脑袋，不断蹭着李青山的裤腿子。

    李青山蹲下去摸了摸大黄的脑袋道：“表现的不错，咱们再往下面走一走，天黑之前回来吃肉，少不了你的。”

    说罢。

    李青山将地上的野兔子拎了起来，大概有四斤多重，只能算是小野兔子，大一些的成年野兔子体重能有六斤多，出肉率大概在六成，也就是能出二斤四两的肉，至于下水内脏什么的也不能浪费，全部留给大黄。

    现在是夏日。

    虽然快要天黑了，温度也下来了，但是比冬天的温度可是要高上不少，必须要尽快将野兔开膛放血才行，否则两个小时内，经过高温反应，这只野兔子的肚子就会产生酵气，变得鼓起来。

    血腥味六分钟内，就可以传到周围一公里的范围。

    放出来的血要及时掩埋才行。

    五分钟后，李青山将处理好的野兔子挂在腰间，继续顺着小溪朝着下游走。

    摸了摸胸口的葫芦吊坠。

    李青山心中有些疑惑，为何刚刚大黄去猎杀野兔的时候，这葫芦吊坠会突然发热一下。

    前世，那老道士只是说这玩意是掌门信物。

    初代掌门。

    就是依靠这玉葫芦吊坠，才开宗立派，其他的也没有多说。

    “咦！！”

    就在李青山刚走两分钟时，胸口的葫芦吊坠竟然再一次微微发热起来，李青山目光朝着大黄看了过去。

    大黄正在满地嗅着猎物的味道，并未有所动静。

    低头香！！

    就是依靠与动物行走过后的残存下来的气味，猎杀猎物。

    若是猎物不是从这地方过去的，自然也就嗅不到了。

    李青山手中猎弓满月。

    瞄准，调整呼吸。

    前方四十多米的地方，正有一只比刚刚还要肥硕的野兔子在啃食水边鲜嫩的青草。

    胸口葫芦吊坠发热的时候，李青山这才立刻警觉朝着四周搜寻。

    果然。

    发现了前方的这只野兔子。

    “欻！！”

    满月的猎弓之上，长箭飞射而出。

    正在啃食鲜嫩青草的野兔子，万万没想到，自己的生命会在今日终结。

    “嘭！”

    一道沉闷声响，长箭瞬间洞穿这只野兔子的颈部，倒在地上不断抽搐着，大黄见状便再次兴奋的冲了上去，将刚刚狩猎到的野兔子叼了回来。

    李青山则是摸了摸自己胸口的玉葫芦吊坠。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Rhubarb is very fast, and so is the hare. However, the hare does not have the endurance, but its explosive power is amazing. If you run for a long time, you will run to death. As long as the terrain is not complicated, the hare cannot escape the hunting of the rhubarb.

but.

There are too many possibilities for rhubarb to hunt hares, and it may also disturb other prey that come to drink water.

Li Qingshan has quick eyes and quick hands, and he can fully draw the long bow in his hand.

Although the strength from the previous life was not inherited, the knowledge and experience from the previous life were perfectly inherited.

The full moon of hunting bows!!

Aim and breathe!

"Tian!"

The next second!

Standing firmly on both feet, the distance between you and the hare is about 1.5 times the width of your shoulders. The leaves in the old forest are rustling softly. The wind speed is about three meters per second. The distance between you and the hare is thirty meters, which is within the effective and precise hunting range.

Slightly deviate from the position of the hare.

In the full moon hunting bow, a long arrow flew out, leaving an afterimage in the sky!

All of this was accomplished in the blink of an eye. Li Qingshan had already memorized the skills of archery. Although he later played with guns, Li Qingshan still liked the ancient longbow, so he often went hunting with those old soldiers.

“Bang!”

There was a dull sound, and before the running hare had time to react, a long arrow instantly pierced the neck!!

The body that was running violently rolled several times and then fell to the ground, twitching continuously.

Dahuang rushed over, picked up the hare and ran towards Li Qingshan, then placed it at Li Qingshan's feet, shook his head, and kept rubbing against Li Qingshan's trouser legs.

Li Qingshan squatted down and touched Dahuang's head and said, "You're doing well. Let's go a little further down there and come back before dark to eat meat. You're indispensable."



Li Qingshan picked up the wild rabbit on the ground. It weighed about four kilograms and could only be regarded as a small wild rabbit. The larger adult wild rabbit could weigh more than six kilograms, and the meat yield rate was about 60%, which means that two kilograms and four taels of meat could be produced. As for the guts and other organs, they could not be wasted, leaving all for rhubarb.

It’s summer now.

Although it is getting dark and the temperature has dropped, it is much higher than the temperature in winter. The hare must be disemboweled and bled as soon as possible. Otherwise, within two hours, after a high-temperature reaction, the hare's belly will produce fermentation and become bulging.

Within six minutes, the smell of blood can spread to the surrounding area of ​​one kilometer.

The released blood must be buried in time.

Five minutes later, Li Qingshan hung the treated wild rabbit on his waist and continued to walk downstream along the stream.

He touched the gourd pendant on his chest.

Li Qingshan was a little confused as to why the gourd pendant suddenly became hot when Dahuang went to hunt hares.

In the previous life, the old Taoist priest just said that this thing was a token of the leader.

The first generation leader.

It was with the help of this jade gourd pendant that the sect was established, and there is not much else to say.

“Eh!!”

Just two minutes after Li Qingshan left, the gourd pendant on his chest became slightly warm again, and Li Qingshan looked towards Dahuang.

Rhubarb was sniffing the smell of prey all over the ground, but made no movement.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​!

It relies on the scent that remains after walking with animals to hunt prey.

If the prey does not pass through this place, it will naturally not be smelled.

The full moon is in Li Qingshan’s hand with the hunting bow.

Aim and adjust your breathing.

More than forty meters ahead, there was a wild rabbit, even fatter than before, gnawing on the fresh grass by the water.

When the gourd pendant on his chest became hot, Li Qingshan immediately became alert and searched around.

​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Found the wild rabbit in front of me.

"Hmm!!"

From the hunting bow under the full moon, a long arrow flew out.

The wild rabbit who was gnawing on the fresh green grass never imagined that his life would end today.

“Bang!”

There was a dull sound, and the long arrow instantly pierced the neck of the wild rabbit. It fell to the ground and kept twitching. Upon seeing this, Rhubarb rushed forward excitedly again and took back the wild rabbit he had just hunted.

Li Qingshan touched the jade gourd pendant on his chest.
